description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!   
At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.   
 Job Description: 
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Front End Software Engineer to join our team! In this role you will get to:

 What You'll Be Doing: 
 Develop and maintain frontend software using JavaScript, React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
 Implement frontend enhancements that improve application usability and user experience.
 Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain software throughout the development lifecycle.
 Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional team members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
 Participate in pair programming, peer reviews, backlog refinement, and sprint planning.
 Investigate and resolve software defects and troubleshoot production issues.
 Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated frontend testing.
 Support the quality of software releases and related test activities.
 Document software, processes, and technical solutions as appropriate.
 Work effectively as part of a fully remote team; occasional travel may be required one to two times per year.
 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 5 years of experience (additional years of experience will be considered in lieu of degree
 Secret clearance is required

 Proficiency in JavaScript, React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
 Experience using Git and modern version-control workflows.
 Experience developing and maintaining frontend applications.
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
 Ability to collaborate effectively through pair programming, peer reviews, and cross-functional teamwork.
 Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
 
 Desired Qualifications: 
 Experience developing automated end-to-end tests using Cypress.
 Experience with Jest, React Testing Library, and unit or integration testing practices.
 Experience with Material UI or similar frontend component libraries.
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Platform One, or DAF CLOUDworks.
 Experience with backend technologies such as Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python.
 Experience with data technologies such as PostgreSQL, Liquibase, SPARQL, Elasticsearch, or Logstash.
 Familiarity with OAuth, JWT, OWASP principles, secure coding practices, CVEs, or penetration testing concepts.
 Experience using Jira for ticket creation and management.
 Experience supporting government, Air Force, COMSEC, CCI, or cryptographic systems.
 
 Security Clearance Requirement: 
An active Secret security clearance is required for this position.​ 
 
This position is part of our Federal Solutions team. 
 
The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now. 
 
Salary Range: $103,500.00 - $181,100.00 
 
 
 
We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle! 
 
 
 
This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled. 
 
Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. 
 
We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY! 
 Parsons is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices. To learn more about recruitment fraud and how to report it, please refer to   https://www.parsons.com/fraudulent-recruitment/ .
